system_prompt_style.note: Pipeline prompts are Jinja-style templates with {{problem_statement}}, {{image_captioning}}, {{sub_image_caption}}. The coding agent itself is external (CodeFuse-Agent), and its system prompt is not in the evidence. Line number is approximate.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
The agent uses grep and glob to per-
form keyword-based searches across the codebase.
env_context_strategy.note: Agent-driven navigation (grep/glob/read) is combined with an injected SVR scene graph of the image and, in refinement rounds, localized code snippets. The quote spans a PDF line break in the evidence.

context_compaction.note: The agent loop lives in the external CodeFuse-Agent repo, which is not in the bundle. Image cropping narrows visual context but is not history compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
the SSG
is serialized into a textual format following Mermaid syntax
observation_format.note: The coding agent receives images as text (the SVR IR). The VLM stages consume screenshots, but these are pipeline inputs, not tool observations.

tool_call_format.note: Agent tool-call parsing is in the external CodeFuse-Agent; src/run_cmd/run_cfuse.py was not included.
